description_en: Calls the GetSet operation to retrieve media set information
description_zh: 调用GetSet接口获取媒体集信息
kebab_example: aliyun imm get-set --project immtest --set-id Set-d7ffb885-88c1-4702-a71f-60cf50c221c9 --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetSet

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the media set
parameters.name: set_id

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the media set

FaceCount.description_en:
The number of faces in the media set.

This parameter is valid only when the media set contains face information
FaceCount.description_zh:
媒体集中的人脸数量。

当媒体集中存在人脸信息时，此参数才有效

ImageCount.description_en:
The number of images in the media set.

This parameter is valid only when the media set contains images
ImageCount.description_zh:
媒体集中的图片数量。

当媒体集中存在图片时，此参数才有效

ModifyTime.description_en:
The modification time of the media set.

If the media set has not been updated since it was created, the modification time is the same as the creation time
ModifyTime.description_zh:
媒体集的修改时间。

创建媒体集后，如果未更新过媒体集，则媒体集的修改时间和媒体集的创建时间相同

SetId.description_en: The unique identifier of the media set, which is the same as the value specified in the request
SetId.description_zh: 媒体集的唯一标识，和请求时一致

SetName.description_en:
The display name of the media set.

If this parameter was not specified when the media set was created, an empty value is returned
SetName.description_zh:
媒体集的显示名称。

如果创建媒体集时未设置此参数，则返回值为空

VideoCount.description_en:
The number of videos in the media set.

This parameter is valid only when the media set contains videos
VideoCount.description_zh:
媒体集中的视频数量。

当媒体集中存在视频时，此参数才有效

VideoLength.description_en:
The total video duration in the media set, in seconds.

This parameter is valid only when the media set contains videos
VideoLength.description_zh:
媒体集中的视频时长，单位为秒。

当媒体集中存在视频时，此参数才有效
